title: dam-break time step and tolerances
reason: For a sudden dam break HEC's 2D guidance is the full-momentum SWE-EM equations with a Courant number at or below 1. This halves the largest Courant number the adaptive step may reach (0.5, never below 0.2) so the front is resolved in more steps, and tightens the 2D water-surface and volume iteration tolerances from 0.01 to 0.001 (with up to 40 iterations), which matter on a thin advancing front.
